title: Control Axis: 24-Layer HfO2/SiO2 Dichroic Stack with Relaxed Thickness Search
scientific_hypothesis: A 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack can achieve high SWIR transmission and UV reflection simultaneously if thicknesses are optimized beyond local minima via wider initialization bounds.
design_principle: Interference filtering using quarter-wave stacks modified for broadband performance. High index contrast (HfO2/SiO2) enables strong UV reflection with fewer layers, leaving room for SWIR transmission tuning.
proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica Substrate
design_variables: Thickness of each of the 24 layers (nm)
manufacturing_considerations: Total layer count fixed at 24 (within 30 limit)
theory_basis: Recalled knowledge of thin-film interference principles for dichroic filters
Recalled knowledge of HfO2/SiO2 refractive index contrast in UV and SWIR bands
Recalled heuristic that wider optimization bounds help escape local minima in multilayer design
expected_advantages: Control arm establishes baseline performance without literature bias
Wider search bounds may escape local minima found in previous iterations
Fixed topology isolates thickness optimization as the sole variable axis
known_risks: Uncertainty in exact n/k values of HfO2 at 300 nm recalled from memory
Risk of absorption in HfO2 at <350 nm not fully accounted for in memory
Initialization bounds may still be too narrow for global optimum despite relaxation
Exact stoichiometry of catalog hfo2 may vary from recalled nominal values
execution_request_english: Optimize the thicknesses of a 24-layer stack on a fused silica substrate. Materials: HfO2 and SiO2 (Lemarchand) alternating, starting with HfO2 on the air side. Sequence: HfO2, SiO2 (Lemarchand), HfO2, SiO2 (Lemarchand), HfO2, SiO2 (Lemarchand), HfO2, SiO2 (Lemarchand), HfO2, SiO2 (Lemarchand), HfO2, SiO2 (Lemarchand), HfO2, SiO2 (Lemarchand), HfO2, SiO2 (Lemarchand), HfO2, SiO2 (Lemarchand), HfO2, SiO2 (Lemarchand), HfO2, SiO2 (Lemarchand), HfO2, SiO2 (Lemarchand). Wavelengths: 300-450 nm (Maximize Reflection), 1000-1700 nm (Maximize Transmission). Incidence: 0 degrees. Initialize thicknesses at [25.0, 70.0, 32.0, 93.0, 67.0, 44.0, 30.0, 45.0, 37.0, 62.0, 39.0, 60.0, 40.0, 63.0, 40.0, 65.0, 61.0, 81.0, 51.0, 62.0, 42.0, 74.0, 38.0, 35.0] nm but allow perturbations up to ±15 nm during search. Max layers 30 (fixed at 24).
revision_reason: Feedback directive to relax thickness initialization bounds to ±15 nm to explore beyond local basin while keeping material stack identical.
